description: Search companies by Korean or English name (q), or list companies whose factory registration lists products in an available category (product). Categories: cosmetic_ingredients (Cosmetic ingredients): cosmetic raw materials and ingredients — the registered product text names them (for example 화장품원료, 화장품소재, 코스메틱원료). Plant or natural extracts listed without a cosmetics word (식물추출물, 천연추출물) also match, so some of those companies make food or supplement ingredients. cosmetics_oem_odm (Finished cosmetics): finished cosmetics — the registered product text names cosmetics (for example 화장품, 기초화장품, 색조화장품, 기능성화장품); rows that only name cosmetic containers, packaging, raw materials or machinery are left out. Despite the id, this data does not say whether a company takes contract-manufacturing or private-label orders. Product results show the registered product text in Korean (first 300 characters; text_truncated=true when cut) with its source (KICOX nationwide registered factories, kicox_factory) and reference date; they show what a factory registered, are not ranked and are not a statement about supply relationships. Returns up to 20 entities; truncated=true means more matched; note carries a caution when an English phrase (not a category id) resolved to a category, for example a contract-manufacturing search. Requires a Jaryo API key.

industry.description: Exact 5-digit KSIC code to narrow a product search to companies whose public DART company profile lists exactly that code (no prefix matching).

product.description: Product category id (cosmetic_ingredients, cosmetics_oem_odm) or an English product phrase (e.g. cosmetic ingredients). Only these categories are available; any other value is rejected (bad-request) and the error lists them.

q.description: Name or part of it (2+ characters; 3+ match any part, 2 match the start of a name). Not with product.

name: search_companies
title: Search Korean companies by name or registered product
